title: Per-Frame Displacement Experiment Brief: Slow vs. Fast Subject in AI Video
purpose: Bounded experiment testing whether LTX image-to-video maintains approximately constant per-frame displacement for fast vs. slow subjects, as the 1914 Horstmann & Tousley book (eBook 45231) specifies as the condition for smooth apparent motion. The brief states the discriminating question, the two contrasting conditions, and what to look for in outputs.
